About

A Cantt staple at Fortress Stadium

Eedon Restaurant sits on Fortress Stadium Circular Road in Saddar Town, Cantt — an easy stop for families and groups eating out in the Fortress Stadium area.

The kitchen covers three cuisines under one roof: Pakistani BBQ and desi favourites, Chinese dishes and soups, and Continental options — so everyone at the table finds something.

With room for 110 guests indoors and listed hours of 11 AM–1 AM, it works just as well for a family dinner as for a late-night bite. Prefer eating at home? Eedon offers home delivery via Foodpanda.
